description: Live-gateway shape: the gateway federates tools as "<server-prefix>-<op>" and slugifies underscores to hyphens, so the tool arrives as "ucp-shop-update-checkout" — no underscore survives. This fixture proves the policy still matches (an underscore-only suffix match would fail open here). Scenario otherwise identical to deny.json: update_checkout response whose grand total ($742.50 = 74250 minor units) is at or above the gateway-supplied approval threshold ($500.00 = 50000), AND no continue_url is present. The agent has a high-value checkout it could complete but no human-review surface, so autonomous completion is refused. Policy should deny with a reason.

expected.reasonContains: at or above the approval threshold
